map.更换涂饰材料（密度/固含量变化）时重算厚度，保持涂层一致。: Recompute the thickness when changing finishing materials (density or solids content changes) to keep the coating consistent.
map.单层干膜厚度(μm) = 用量(g/m²) × 固含量% ÷ 100 ÷ 密度(: Single layer dry film thickness (μm) = usage (g/m²) × solids% ÷ 100 ÷ density (g/cm³). Derivation: the product of usage and solids content is the solid mass left per square meter (g/m²); dividing by the density gives the volume (cm³/m²), and numerically 1 cm³/m² = 1 μm. Total thickness = base + middle + top.
map.底涂用量 30 g/m²、固含量 40%、密度 1.1 g/cm³：30×40/: Base coat 30 g/m², 40% solids, density 1.1 g/cm³: 30×40/100/1.1 ≈ 10.9 μm. Middle coat 40 g/m², 45%, 1.2: 40×45/100/1.2 = 15.0 μm. Top coat 20 g/m², 30%, 1.0: 20×30/100/1.0 = 6.0 μm. Total thickness ≈ 31.9 μm.
map.为什么用固含量而不是直接用涂布量？: Why use solids content instead of the coating amount directly?
map.涂布量含溶剂/水分，干燥后挥发，真正留在皮面的是固体分；只有乘以固含量才是成膜物: The coating amount includes solvent and water, which evaporate on drying; what actually stays on the hide is the solid fraction. Only multiplying by the solids content gives the film-forming material that determines the final dry film thickness.
map.涂层越厚越好吗？: Is a thicker coating always better?
map.不是。涂层过厚会掩盖天然粒面、手感发硬，弯曲时易裂浆；一般在满足遮盖与物性要求下: No. A coat that is too thick hides the natural grain and feels stiff, and it tends to crack when bent; in general keep it as thin as possible while meeting coverage and property requirements.
